notes.title: 1.0 IS HERE!
notes.content:
Thanks to our amazing community, XENOTILT has completed its journey from Early Access to full release! Version 1.0 is our most polished build yet, prepared to bring the best experience possible.

Since launching Early Access in 2023, we’ve added two new game modes, optimized the codebase, and incorporated numerous bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements—all based on your feedback and support.

To celebrate, we’re introducing Steam badges and trading cards! Collect these virtual items as you play through the new 1.0 content. Plus, the full XENOTILT soundtrack will be dropping soon on Steam—so stay tuned.

[b]A Note on Pricing[/b]: We'll be raising the price in the new year, so if you’ve been on the fence, now’s the time to jump in and grab XENOTILT at its current price!

Incase you missed it here is what has been added since Early Access Launch!!

[i]P.S. like what you see/playing consider dropping a review! :)[/i]

[h2]EX-MODE![/h2]
[i]EX-CLUSIVE Bonus Rooms. EX-TREME power-ups. EX-TENDED challenge!![/i]

EX-MODE is the expanded version of Arcade/Normal Mode. It features 3 bonus areas with new bosses and a Billiards inspired "Gravity Pool" table. Also with expanded mechanics like the "Tri-Gift" after "Core Overkill" you can hit 1 of 3 targets for new one-ff abilities such as "Dwarf Star" a 4 way star-shaped laser that clears the screen. An expanded OST was produced for these areas. This was a sizable content update for XENOTILT. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/27978cb68daa7bf846d1002ac383623ee8267a64.jpg[/img]
[b]R&D Lab:[/b] A full size 2-flipper table. A MECHA T-REX is under secret development! Avoid it’s teeth and go for the heart! Has some neat transforming surprises and a slew of attacks including Meteor Showers and Ice Beams.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/1b8b26f49dbdba9a084eba53cfd25d519cb4d4e1.jpg[/img]
[b]The Tomb:[/b] A 4 flippered, full size pinball table in Its own right with a unique multiball mode accessed via a Golden Scarab. Do battle against an Undead Pharaoh. Avoid its mythical Sword and goad it out of the shadows by lighting torches. Features a unique Multiball Lock.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/b7b4f761183f2ce8c125c41cc088a16ce483def1.jpg[/img]
[b]Gravity Pool: [/b]Hosted by a Golden Dragon, Take a breather with a game of Billiards with unique rules. Chain together sequences/combos for big points. Sink Billiards to earn Prizes that will supercharge the main table.


[h2]EX-SURVIVORS [/h2]
[i]Rescue hidden SURVIVORS. Hire them for unique BONUS SKILLS![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/133b3aae5d4aac85a1050d8c2d622bd3cc142b54.jpg[/img]
In EX-MODE when you complete objectives related to the Bonus Areas a “Rescue Shot” will show up on the Tier 1 Airlock, hit the Airlock to rescue a Survivor.

This is a carry-over progression system, from the Main Menu you can see the Survivor Table and start hiring your team of up to 12. Each Survivor has a unique “Bonus Skill” which acts as perma-buffs to gameplay. Earn Bonus Tokens by doing Protocols so you can hire more expensive Survivors. 


[h2]CRISIS MODE[/h2]
[i]CHAOTIC TIME ATTACK. Go the distance and enter SUDDEN DEATH![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/b2b1fe4c5f7d41f29439854f1946e1f9ef05e43d.jpg[/img]

A Time based challenge mode. Try and last 10 minutes as the clock ticks down rapidly. Make it to sudden death and squeeze out what precious points you can before your inevitable end to a slowly rising death-laser. 

Your time is your score, new time based targets (gates) can be completed in sequence for larger time based bonuses. 

Thank you! THANK YOU!!

[i]P.P.S. Remember folks: As long as gravity exists, PINBALL NEVER DIES!![/i]

notes.title: WE'RE ALMOST OUT OF EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
[h1]BUGS SMASHERS, SALUTE![/h1]
Thanks to everyone who played and gave feedback on the bugsmashers branch, we're now ready to put the 1.0 preview in the main branch. This includes all the new content, bug fixes, and QOL improvements previously only available in bugsmashers. While there are still some known bugs remaining, releasing to a wider audience will help us track down solutions for the last ones. 

If you happen to have video capture of bugs, please link it in the forums. Especially replays on twitch that show context.

We will be leaving Early Access soon. Remember, once we're out of EA, the price will be increased. You still have a chance to get in at the ground floor if you haven't bought [b]XENOTILT[/b] already. If you want to be notified of sales, wishlist it!

For those of you not familiar with the content in the 1.0 preview, here's a brief rundown:

[list]
[*] EX-MODE is here!
[*] EX-SURVIVORS ready up!
[*] CRISIS MODE starts the clock!
[*] 3 New Bonus Areas in EX-MODE.
[*] 3 New Music Tracks join the OST.
[*] Major Performance Improvements.
[*] Various Bug fixes.
[/list]

We will be putting this out as .9. It's not quite 1.0 as there still are some minor bugs, features, and QOL updates we plan on adding before we call it 1.0.

Don't worry--there's still more to come from us once we're in full 1.0 release. This includes a soundtrack release among other things.

[i]WELL DONE P.A.L.A.D.I.N.[/i]

notes.title: 1.0 BETA IS HERE!
notes.content:
[h2]TRY THE 1.0 PUBLIC BETA![/h2]

Ok! We said Friday is the day, and we weren't kidding! 

[b]Owner's of XENOTILT, right click on game in library, Properties>Betas> select the [i]bugsmashers[/i] branch from the beta settings.[/b]

[h3]Why are we putting it in the beta branch?[/h3]

We want feedback from you! We want to incorporate notes from the community on balance, bugs, and tuning before we transition out of Early Access. So BUGSMASHERS feel free to light up our forums with your suggestions! That's not to say XENOTILT's support ends at 1.0. We have a lot of plans for this game. After all, we're still updating [i]DEMON'S TILT,[/i] too.

If you like what you see, and haven't dropped a review, please do so, thanks!

[i]-Ralph Barbagallo[/i]

[h3]WORDS FROM WIZNWAR[/h3]

It's been quite a journey, what should've been a piecemeal rollout of the two modes, I decided to finish together. It was hard to get a "complete picture" of the game's breadth without working them both up simultaneously.  

Looking for balance change feedback!

Bugs are expected, please report them to the correct forum, you can make a new thread per issue.
if you are an expert BUGMASHER, please drop footage, streams, youtube links, anything video so I can see the repro on video it helps immensely.  

[i]-WIZNWAR[/i]

notes.title: DINOS vs. ROBOTS SALE & the FUTURE of XENOTILT!
notes.content:
[h1]2024 AND THE ROAD TO 1.0[/h1]
[h2]DINOS VS. ROBOTS FEST! XENOTILT, on sale now! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/09d39a33cd26cbf3b0fa4d6836251ff2b26b0eb2.jpg[/img]

[b]ANNOUNCING[/b]

Keep your eyes out for the Public Beta coming soon!! (shooting for later this week) 
Owners of XENOTILT will be able to opt into a Public Beta!

2024 will conclude our journey to the 1.0 full release. The next step on this journey is the introduction of two new modes: [b]CRISIS [/b]and [b]EX-SURVIVORS MODE[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/b2b1fe4c5f7d41f29439854f1946e1f9ef05e43d.jpg[/img]

[b]CRISIS MODE[/b] 

A brand new Time Attack mode for XENOTILT--battle against the clock, when the clock hits [b]ZERO[/b] it's [i]GAME OVER[/i]. Your time survived is your score! Level up by collecting blue CHRONO MEDALS. On level-up you earn precious seconds. Select unique rewards via the new "TRI-GIFT".  Hit Time Targets, to extend the clock. Survive 10 MINUTES and enter SUDDEN DEATH where the true CRISIS SURVIVORS emerge. Crisis Mode is all about a fast play session, it has a quick retry screen to get you going instantly. 

[b]EX-MODE[/b] 

Like the EX-MODE from DEMON'S TILT, the SAMARITAN has been tuned for added difficulty, new rules, 3 Hidden Areas to explore, and new Meta Progression system called "EX-SURVIVORS". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/133b3aae5d4aac85a1050d8c2d622bd3cc142b54.jpg[/img]

[b]EX-SURVIVORS[/b] 

Rescue Survivors from the SAMARITAN! Clear Bonus Areas for a chance to find them. Currency earned during gameplay allows you to hire these Survivors before your next run. Survivors unlock new capabilities by way of their unique "BONUS SKILL". There are many Survivors to discover, how many can you find? Min-Max your team to get an edge over EX-MODE. 

[b]BONUS AREAS[/b] 

Like in DEMON'S TILT, EX-MODE offers 3 new Bonus Areas to explore with 3 new screen-filling BOSSES. You're in for a treat here, with complexity far beyond what DT offered. 

[b]NEW MUSIC[/b] 

3 new original pieces of music join the OST!! (E.C.2151 shreds!)

[b]SEE YA SOON![/b] 

These new modes have been tested internally for MONTHS. But it's time we let the XENOTILT community check it out and provide feedback. It includes a massive amount of bug/performance fixes in addition to this new content. We're not quite ready to put this new content in the main branch--but once we've incorporated of your feedback and completed the localization we'll be ready!

Spread the word, let the other PINBALL WIZARDS know!! Thanks P.A.L.A.D.I.N.!!

notes.title: I STILL FUNCTION.
notes.content:
[h1]AFTER ACTION REPORT[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544534/aaf1e2728f224ec8ead6405074c04d21b03df6a5.png[/img]

Well the 2nd public playtest happened, and my first time truly seeing the game played. 4 solid days with lines, so as many people as possible got to play. 

I now have an accurate picture of how done the game is and... It's closer to release than I thought! (Still no date, [i]sorry![/i])

A lot of fans of Demon's Tilt stopped by, A shocking amount, I was caught off guard completely and lost count.  Many people knew [b]DEMON'S TILT[/b] but had no idea [b]XENOTILT [/b]existed, but hey that's our marketing problem. ([i]What are those guys doing anyway!?[/i])

Anyway, this made the show for me--It's energizing to find out what you do matters and have that feedback come full circle.

[list]
[*]Got my bug list for an EA release.
[*]The Normal Mode plays great, and as intended. Some balancing issues.
[*]There wasn't a fan of DT that thought XT missed the mark. huge for me.
[*]Crisis Mode (a new time attack mode) needs a lot more work, but I kind of don't want to delay EA release.
[*]Hardcore Mode will need to be more difficult.
[*]Tate Mode work will start. 
[*]I will put in some tweaks that make ball 2 and 3 different to give more of an arc to a 3 Ball game.
[*]People picked up on the turret system fast 
[*]Turret cont. But for new players who want to focus on flipping. I'll need to put in a safety if the board gets stuffed, they will auto-fire
[*]Performance needs more work, as expected. I like high refresh rate where available, there's no going back.
[*]The OST was recently finished, EC2151 returns for another banger. Features a special cut from our Original Sound Designer HEAVYVIPER.
[*]EX-MODE content was started last Nov. to give you an idea of where that's at.
[/list]
That's my update for now.

As long as gravity exists, [b]PINBALL NEVER DIES[/b].

-[b][i]WIZNWAR [/i][/b]
